description: Unmarked F-104A on a paved apron beside the Ajloun to Amman road. The International F-104 Society attributes it to construction number 183-1070 and serial 922 but states in the same entry that it wears no markings and is very hard to identify, and notes that the split tailplane shows it was one of the Mirage F1 decoys at Mafraq, so no tail number is asserted. First noted around 2010. Clearly visible as an aircraft on Esri imagery of 7 May 2025.
